text:
elaine: Quick sync — we need to change the audit event envelope to include `envelope_version` (int) and standardize actor as `subject.id` instead of the legacy `actor_id` alias. This will be customer-visible. Planning a soft roll with dual-write for ~3 weeks. Thoughts? :wave:

samir: what's the reason for envelope_version vs event.version? can we reuse existing field to avoid client churn? :thinking:

elaine: We tried `event.version` but it's overloaded. Envelope gives room for transport metadata (schema changes, provenance) and makes future changes less painful. Also needed for per-tenant KMS key mapping. Short migration plan in the PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/4567

jordan: will this affect downstream SIEM parsers? We should add a compatibility header `X-Audit-Schema: v1` for the transitional period.

maria: Agree on header. Also need to update KMS key metadata — key rotation will change `kms_key_id` format. Ops: can you list consumers that read `actor_id`? I can notify top customers and SOCs.

devops-bot: deploy pipeline note — canary envs will run dual-write when flag `audit_envelope_dual_write` enabled. See: `infra/flags/audit_envelope_dual_write`

samir: quick compat check: can you paste sample payloads so I can run parsers locally?

elaine: pasted examples below:
```
old: {"event_type":"access.granted","actor_id":"u_123","resource":"/models/rr"}
new: {"envelope_version":2,"subject":{"id":"u_123","type":"user"},"event":{"type":"access.granted","resource":"/models/rr"},"kms_key_id":"projects/prod/keys/k-abc-2026"}
```

jordan: will the schema validator reject old events after cutoff? we need a migration timeline + gating metric.

elaine: plan: week1 dual-write, week2 client opt-in and validation, week3 cutover with auto-backoff to v1 on errors. gating: <0.1% invalid events surface to analytics consumers and zero customer-facing incidents for 48h.

maria: I'll draft a customer-facing validation checklist and a lightweight CLI validator tool zip that customers can run against their pipelines. Sharing with legal for wording.

samir: RBAC impact: with `subject.type` we can remove `actor_role` alias down the line. Need to update authz mapping tables and feature flags for role-based ingress.

security-bot: flagged for review — please fill the security checklist in the PR: encryption in transit, KMS key access patterns, HSM attestation notes, and audit retention mapping.

elaine: Action items recap:
- @maria prepare customer note + validation tool (due EOD Wed)
- @samir enumerate consumers and attest compat (due Fri)
- @jordan add validator header support + analytics gating (due Thu)
- @devops-bot enable dual-write in canary 1 (scheduled Tue at 02:00 UTC)

maria: ack :thumbsup: I'll start the draft and share the checklist link.

samir: ack, I'll run parser inventory and post a short list of owners + contact points.

jordan: creating PR to add `X-Audit-Schema` header + validator rule. Pinging sig-analytics for gating metrics.

elaine: thanks all — syncing w/ infra on the KMS mapping plan later today. Ping me if you hit blockers or if a customer asks for accelerated timeline. :eyes:
